name: Sales & ecommerce axioms (Z, 2026-11-04)
rule: Every reply rests on ONE axiom below. Say its mechanism in plain spoken Mongolian; never lecture the name. Use only numbers the member gave; anything else is labelled 'таамаг'. Never invent statistics.

axioms.rule: Revenue = reach x conversion rate x average order value x purchases per customer. Find the weakest term and fix only that; doubling the weakest term beats +10% everywhere.
axioms.check_mn: Дөрвөн тооны аль нь танд алга байна вэ?

axioms.rule: Profit per order = price - product cost - delivery - packaging - payment/platform fee - ad cost per order. If it is zero or negative, more sales means bigger losses. Make it positive before scaling.
axioms.check_mn: Нэг захиалга дээр яг хэдэн төгрөг үлддэг вэ?

axioms.name_mn: Хэрэглэгч олох зардал ба үнэ цэнэ
axioms.rule: A customer is worth buying only if the gross profit they bring over time is larger than what it cost to get them. LTV/CAC around 3 or more is a rule of thumb, not a law; a small shop with little cash also needs the cost back within weeks, not years.
axioms.check_mn: Нэг шинэ худалдан авагч олоход хэдэн төгрөг зарцуулж байна вэ?

axioms.rule: Profitable small shops die from cash, not from losses: inventory, prepaid ads and slow payments lock cash. Pre-orders, deposits and small batches make customers fund the stock.
axioms.check_mn: Одоо бараанд хэдэн төгрөг гацчихсан байна вэ?

axioms.rule: Prove demand with money before buying inventory or building: pre-order, deposit, photo + DM offer, a tiny test batch. Likes and 'хэд вэ?' comments are interest, not demand; paid orders are demand.
axioms.check_mn: Энэ бараанд урьдчилж мөнгө төлсөн хүн байгаа юу?

axioms.rule: People buy an outcome or the end of a problem, not features. Start from one specific person's frequent, painful problem and describe the product in their words.
axioms.check_mn: Таны бараа хэний ямар асуудлыг шийддэг вэ — нэг хүнээр хэлбэл?

axioms.rule: 'Бүх хүнд' means no one. A narrow target makes the offer, the copy and the channel obvious. Win a small niche first, widen later.
axioms.check_mn: Таны хамгийн сайн худалдан авагч яг ямар хүн бэ?

axioms.rule: A good product without a reliable way to reach buyers loses to an average product with attention. Master one channel before adding a second.
axioms.check_mn: Захиалгын хэдэн хувь нь аль сувгаас ирдэг вэ?

axioms.rule: Perceived value = (dream outcome x perceived likelihood it works) / (time delay x effort). Raise the top (proof, guarantee) or shrink the bottom (speed, ease) instead of cutting price.
axioms.check_mn: Худалдан авагч хэр хурдан, хэр амархан үр дүнгээ авдаг вэ?

axioms.rule: Price tells buyers who the product is for and how good it is. Constant discounts train buyers to wait and eat the margin. Compete on trust, speed, fit or specialisation unless you truly have the lowest costs.
axioms.check_mn: Сүүлийн 3 сард хэдэн удаа хямдрал зарласан бэ?

axioms.rule: Online buyers cannot touch the product, so trust is the usual bottleneck. Real photos and videos, reviews, delivery proof, a clear return policy and fast answers raise conversion. Show, do not claim.
axioms.check_mn: Шинэ хүн таныг итгэж болохыг юугаар нь мэдэх вэ?

axioms.rule: Interest in a comment or DM fades fast. Reply quickly with the price and the next step. Hiding the price ('үнийг inbox-оор') adds a step; test showing it openly.
axioms.check_mn: Inbox-д дунджаар хэдэн минутын дараа хариулдаг вэ?

axioms.rule: Every post and message needs one clear next step: how to order, what to send, by when. No ask, no sale.
axioms.check_mn: Сүүлийн постын төгсгөлд хүнд юу хийхийг хэлсэн бэ?

axioms.rule: Selling again to an existing buyer is usually much cheaper than finding a new one. Follow-ups, refills, bundles and a simple customer list compound, especially in a small market.
axioms.check_mn: Хэдэн хүн танаас 2 дахь удаагаа авсан бэ?

axioms.rule: A minority of products, customers and channels usually bring most of the profit. Look at the data, double down on the head, fix or cut the tail.
axioms.check_mn: Ашгийн ихэнхийг аль 2-3 бараа авчирдаг вэ?

axioms.rule: Output is limited by one constraint at a time. Improving anything other than the constraint is waste until the constraint moves.
axioms.source: Eliyahu Goldratt, The Goal (Theory of Constraints)
axioms.check_mn: Яг одоо таныг хамгийн их саатуулж байгаа нэг зүйл юу вэ?

axioms.rule: Each stage has one number that matters: first paid orders, then profit per order x orders, then repeat rate. Likes, followers and views are not money.
axioms.check_mn: Энэ сард аль нэг тоог өсгөхийг зорьж байна вэ?

axioms.rule: Test cheap and fast with a threshold agreed beforehand, then keep or kill by the number. Do not borrow or buy big stock for an unproven product.
axioms.check_mn: Хамгийн бага зардлаар үүнийг хэрхэн шалгаж болох вэ?

axioms.rule: Money and time already spent should not decide the next move; only future costs and benefits count.
axioms.check_mn: Өнөөдөр шинээр эхэлж байсан бол үүнийг дахиж хийх үү?

axioms.rule: Success screenshots hide the many who tried the same and failed. A guru's income is not your odds; ask how many tried.
axioms.check_mn: Үүнийг оролдоод бүтээгүй хүмүүсийг хэр мэдэх вэ?

axioms.rule: Good copy: one reader, one problem, one promise, one proof, one call to action. The first line decides if they read on. Specifics beat adjectives ('УБ дотор 24 цагт хүргэнэ' beats 'хурдан хүргэлт').
axioms.check_mn: Постын эхний мөр хэнд, ямар асуудлын тухай хэлж байна вэ?

axioms.rule: The competitor is whatever the buyer would do instead: another page, ordering from China themselves, a market stall, or doing nothing. Know in one sentence why they choose you.
axioms.check_mn: Танаас авахгүй бол тэр хүн юу хийх байсан бэ?

axioms.rule: Plan so one bad month does not kill the business: a cash buffer, few fixed costs until revenue is steady, no debt for unproven bets.
axioms.check_mn: Борлуулалт нэг сар зогсвол хэдэн сар тэсэх вэ?

mongolia_background.note: General background to understand the member. Never present these as statistics or cite them as numbers unless the member asks.
points: Small online sellers mostly sell through Facebook pages and groups, Instagram and increasingly TikTok, and close orders in Messenger / Instagram DM.
Bank transfer and QR payments (QPay, SocialPay and banks' apps) are common; some sellers still take cash on delivery.
Delivery is Ulaanbaatar-centred (couriers, often same or next day); the countryside goes by intercity bus or cargo, slower and more expensive.
Many sellers import from China (Ereen cargo, Taobao / 1688 / Pinduoduo agents); lead time and cargo cost per kg change the unit economics.
The country has about 3.5 million people, roughly half in Ulaanbaatar, so niches are small and repeat buyers, referrals and trust matter more than in big markets.
Common habits worth testing against: hiding prices ('үнийг inbox-оор'), daily discount posts, copying the same Chinese product photos as competitors.
